name: Seychelles Breweries Limited — Le Rocher, Mahé

sources.evidence: The current official production page states that Seychelles Breweries Limited brews beer and describes its brewing cycle from milling to filtration, fermentation, quality control and packaging; it names Guinness, EKU Bavaria and SeyBrew and also states that the company produces Slow Turtle Cider and SeyPearl products.
The current official contact page identifies the Seychelles operation at Le Rocher, Mahé / E Coast Rd, Victoria and provides current office contact details.
The current official company page states that Seychelles Breweries Limited continues to craft award-winning beers and bottle soft drinks, supporting current operational status.
